casella_collegata.testo: Reading and sending are allowed. Check the initial import below.

permessi_incompleti.testo: Google didn’t grant both reading and sending. Choose Authorise and allow both on the consent screen.

da_ricollegare.testo: Choose Reconnect so the app can keep syncing while you’re away.

casella_non_trovata.testo: This mailbox was disconnected or no longer exists.

richiesta_non_valida.testo: The request expired or was started in another session. Try again.

consenso_negato.testo: Nothing changed. You can try again whenever you like.

account_di_altro_utente.titolo: This mailbox belongs to another user
account_di_altro_utente.testo: A mailbox can be connected by only one user of the app at a time.

account_diverso_da_quello_atteso.titolo: A different Google account was chosen
account_diverso_da_quello_atteso.testo: To reconnect or authorise a mailbox, choose that mailbox’s own Google account.

pauseAttive.testo: Mail keeps syncing. Analysis resumes once the cause is fixed.

caselle.ricollegaTesto: Google access was revoked or has expired, so syncing is paused. Reconnect the same account: your data is kept.
caselle.autorizzaTesto: Reading or sending wasn’t allowed. Authorise again and allow both on Google’s consent screen.
caselle.scollegamentoInCorso: Disconnecting: Google access is being revoked and this mailbox’s data deleted.

stima.testo: {numero, plural, =0 {no emails to analyse} one {# email to analyse} other {# emails to analyse}} · about {costo}
stima.requisiti: Accept the privacy notice and save a valid key first:
stima.primaAccesso: Reconnect or authorise this mailbox first.

scollega.revoca: The app’s access to this mailbox is revoked at Google.
scollega.dati: This mailbox’s emails and analyses are deleted, with the actions, waiting items and Situations that come only from them.
scollega.altre: Emails that are also in another connected mailbox stay.
scollega.nuovaImportazione: Connecting it again later starts a new initial import.

esiti.gia_decisa: This import has already started or changed. The page shows its current state.
esiti.non_trovata: This mailbox is no longer connected.
esiti.non_valido: The request isn’t valid. Reload the page.
esiti.casella_non_pronta: Reconnect or authorise this mailbox before starting the import.

chiave.nessuna: No key saved: AI analysis is paused until you add one.
chiave.aiutoCredito: Add credit or raise the key’s limit on OpenRouter.
chiave.consiglio: Tip: use a key just for this app, with a credit limit. Whether OpenRouter logs requests is up to your OpenRouter account settings.

esiti.non_valida: OpenRouter rejected this key. It was saved as not valid, so AI analysis is paused until you add a working key.
esiti.credito_esaurito: The key was saved, but it has no credit left. AI analysis stays paused until credit is available.
esiti.errore_temporaneo: OpenRouter couldn’t be reached. Nothing was saved; try again in a moment.
esiti.formato_non_valido: This doesn’t look like an OpenRouter key (it starts with sk-or-). Nothing was saved.

rimuovi.pausa: AI analysis pauses, and the app asks for a new key before showing your home. Mail keeps syncing.
rimuovi.openrouter: The key is deleted only from this app. To revoke it, delete it on OpenRouter too.

modelli.descrizione: Each AI function runs on its own OpenRouter model.

classificazione_priorita.descrizione: Reads received emails to spot urgent mail and News & FYI, and set priorities.

estrazione_attivita.descrizione: Reads received, sent and internal mail to find actions and deadlines.

attese_risposte.descrizione: Reads sent and received mail to track what you’re waiting on and spot replies.

riepilogo_news.descrizione: Reads the last 24 hours of News & FYI to write the digest.

bozze_assistite.descrizione: Reads the email you’re answering and its thread to suggest a draft. Never sends.

sconosciuta.descrizione: An AI function of the app.

statiAiuto.incompatibile: Paused: this model may keep your data or can’t answer in the format the app needs. Choose another one.
statiAiuto.non_disponibile: Paused: this model isn’t available on OpenRouter. Choose another one.

esiti.incompatibile: This model may keep your data or can’t answer in the required format. Choose another one.
esiti.non_disponibile: This model isn’t available on OpenRouter. Check the ID.
esiti.non_valido: The request isn’t valid. Reload the page.

modelli.aiutoCampo: Format: provider/model, as on openrouter.ai/models. Only models that keep no data and can answer in the app’s format are accepted.

predefinite.testo: They’re saved as a new version. Your current text stays in the version history.

esiti.vuoto: Write your directives first, or restore the defaults.
esiti.troppo_lungo: The text is too long (up to 20,000 characters).
esiti.non_valido: The request isn’t valid. Reload the page.

contesto.aiuto: Applies to new emails; use <rianalisi>Reanalyse</rianalisi> for older ones. The app’s safeguards always stay on.

preferenze.linguaAiuto: AI-written text keeps the language of each email.

pausa.siFermaTesto: Analysis of new mail, the News digest, suggested drafts and reanalysis.
pausa.continuaTesto: Mail sync, reading your emails, your actions, waiting items and corrections, and sending drafts you confirm.
pausa.ripresa: When you resume, emails that arrived in the meantime are analysed.
pausa.attivaTesto: Pausing stops all AI calls and spending. Mail keeps syncing.
pausa.inPausaTesto: No AI calls, nothing spent. Mail keeps syncing.

consumo.nessuno: No AI calls in the last 30 days.
consumo.riepilogo: Last 30 days: {costo} · {chiamate, plural, one {# AI call} other {# AI calls}}
consumo.fonte: Your OpenRouter account has the exact figures.

rianalisi.descrizione: Re-run the analysis with your current AI context and models. Your corrections are kept.
rianalisi.ambitoGiorni: Emails from the last {giorni, plural, one {day} other {# days}}
rianalisi.numero: {numero, plural, =0 {No emails to reanalyse} one {# email to reanalyse} other {# emails to reanalyse}}
rianalisi.prezziMancanti: Price not available for: {funzioni}. The estimate leaves them out.
rianalisi.pausaAttiva: AI analysis is paused: the reanalysis starts once analysis resumes.

esiti.ok: Reanalysis started. It runs in the background; follow it on the Status page.
esiti.stima_scaduta: This estimate is no longer valid. Estimate again.
esiti.non_trovata: This estimate no longer exists. Estimate again.

privacy.nonAccettata: You haven’t accepted the current privacy notice (version {versione}). AI analysis stays paused until you do.

account.descrizione: Delete your account and everything the app stores about you.
account.titoloConferma: Delete your account and all its data?
account.caselle: Every connected mailbox is disconnected and its Google access revoked.
account.dati: Emails, analyses, Situations, drafts, your AI context and your OpenRouter key are deleted.
account.backup: Database backups keep data until their retention period ends, as the privacy notice explains.
account.uscita: You’re signed out right away. This can’t be undone.
account.capisco: I understand that my account and data will be deleted for good.
account.errore: The account couldn’t be deleted. Try again.
